items.q:
A: Where (　) you last weekend?
B: I was at my grandmother's house.
items.ex: last weekend(先週末)の話で主語が you なので were です。

items.q: I usually (　) the dishes after dinner.
items.ex: wash the dishes で「皿を洗う」。

items.q: My sister can speak English and French. She is good at (　).
items.ex: 英語とフランス語を話せる→ languages(言語)が得意。

items.q:
A: (　) is your new bike?
B: It's the red one over there.
items.ex: 「どれがあなたの新しい自転車?」なので Which(どれ)。

items.q: Tom was (　) a bath when I called him.
items.ex: was のあとに ing 形で「(そのとき)～していた」。過去進行形です。

items.q: This question is (　) difficult than that one.
items.ex: than があるので比較級。difficult のような長い語は more をつけます。

items.q: We (　) go to school on Saturday. We have no classes.
items.ex: 授業がないので「行かなくてよい」= don't have to。

items.q:
A: Will it be sunny tomorrow?
B: No, it (　).
items.ex: Will ～? には Yes, it will. / No, it won't. で答えます。

items.q: I have a lot of homework (　) do today.
items.ex: homework to do で「やるべき宿題」。to ～ が後ろから名詞を説明します。

items.q: My father (　) to Osaka on business next week.
items.ex: next week(来週)の予定なので is going(行く予定)。

items.q: Please (　) off your shoes here.
items.ex: take off で「脱ぐ」。put on(着る・はく)と反対です。

items.q: The movie was very (　). Everyone laughed a lot.
items.ex: みんなたくさん笑った→ funny(おもしろい)。

items.q: Ken got up early (　) catch the first train.
items.ex: to ～ で「～するために」(目的)。

items.q:
A: How (　) does it take from here to the station?
B: About ten minutes.
items.ex: かかる時間は How long ～? でたずねます。

items.q: Mary is (　) than her sister.
items.ex: than があるので比較級 taller。

items.q:
Girl: Can you come to my birthday party on Sunday?
Boy: (　) I have a piano lesson.
items.ex: ピアノのレッスンがある→「ごめん、行けない」。

items.q:
Mother: Did you clean your room, Kevin?
Boy: (　) I'll do it now.
items.ex: 「今からやる」と言っているので Not yet.(まだ)。

items.q:
Man: What would you like to drink?
Woman: (　)
items.ex: 飲み物を聞かれているので飲み物で答えます。

items.q:
Boy 1: I'm going to the zoo with my family tomorrow.
Boy 2: (　) Have a good time!
items.ex: 「楽しそうだね。楽しんでね!」という流れです。

items.q:
Girl: Whose umbrella is this?
Boy: (　) My name is on it.
items.ex: 「名前が書いてある」ので It's mine.(ぼくのだ)。

items.jp: あなたは昨日何時に寝ましたか。
items.ex: What time(何時)のあとに did you go to bed と続けます。
items.full: What time did you go to bed yesterday?

items.jp: 私は将来、先生になりたいです。
items.ex: want to be ～ で「～になりたい」。I want to be a teacher in the future.
items.full: I want to be a teacher in the future.

items.jp: 私の兄は私より速く走ることができます。
items.ex: can run のあとに faster than me(私より速く)。
items.full: My brother can run faster than me.

items.jp: 駅への道を教えてくれませんか。
items.ex: Could you tell me the way to ～? で道をたずねる定番の形です。
items.full: Could you tell me the way to the station?

items.jp: 私の町には大きな公園が2つあります。
items.ex: There are のあとに two big parks、最後に場所 in my town。
items.full: There are two big parks in my town.

parts.title: 日本文付き短文の語句整序

blocks.label: [A]
blocks.title: City Pool
blocks.body:
Summer Swimming Class
For junior high school students
Dates: July 25 to July 29
Time: 9:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.
Place: City Pool
Price: 2,000 yen for five days
Please bring a swimsuit, a towel, and a swimming cap.
Teachers from the Green Swimming Club will teach you.
To join, please call the City Pool by July 20.
Phone: 555-0198

qs.q: How many days is the swimming class?
qs.ex: July 25 から July 29 まで、for five days とあります。

o: a swimsuit, a towel, and a swimming cap.
qs.ex: Please bring a swimsuit, a towel, and a swimming cap. とあります。

blocks.label: [B]
blocks.body:
From: Ryo Tanaka
To: Sam Miller
Date: October 3
Subject: School festival

Hi Sam,
How are you? Next Saturday, we're going to have a school festival. My class is going to have a coffee shop. I'm going to make cookies with my friends. Can you come? It starts at ten in the morning. My parents will come, too. Also, our brass band will play music in the gym at one o'clock. My sister plays the flute in the band.
Your friend,
Ryo

From: Sam Miller
To: Ryo Tanaka
Date: October 4
Subject: Sounds great!

Hi Ryo,
Thanks for inviting me! I'd love to come. But I have a soccer game in the morning, so I'll arrive at about noon. I'll buy some of your cookies! I want to listen to your sister's band, too. Can I bring my brother? He's in the fourth grade, and he loves cookies.
See you on Saturday,
Sam

qs.q: What is Ryo going to do at the festival?
qs.ex: I'm going to make cookies with my friends. とあります。

qs.q: Why will Sam arrive at about noon?
o: He has a soccer game in the morning.
He has to help his brother.
qs.ex: I have a soccer game in the morning とあります。

qs.q: Who wants to come with Sam?
qs.ex: Can I bring my brother? と聞いています。

blocks.label: [C]
blocks.title: Lucas and the Lost Dog
blocks.body:
Lucas is twelve years old and lives in a city in Brazil. One rainy evening last winter, he found a small dog in front of his house. The dog was wet and very hungry. Lucas brought it into the house and gave it some milk and bread.
His mother said, "This dog may have a family. We should look for its owner." The next day, Lucas made some posters with a picture of the dog. He put them on the walls of the supermarket and the station. He also asked his friends to tell other people about it.
For three days, nobody called. Lucas started to think, "Maybe I can keep this dog." But on the fourth day, an old woman called. "That's my dog, Bolt!" she said. She came to Lucas's house, and the dog ran to her happily.
The woman thanked Lucas and gave him a cake. She also said, "Please come and visit Bolt any time." Now Lucas visits her house every Sunday. He walks Bolt in the park, and the woman tells him stories about her life. Lucas wants to work with animals in the future.

qs.q: What did Lucas give the dog first?
qs.ex: gave it some milk and bread とあります。

qs.q: Where did Lucas put the posters?
o: At the supermarket and the station.
qs.ex: on the walls of the supermarket and the station とあります。

qs.q: When did the old woman call?
qs.ex: on the fourth day, an old woman called とあります。

qs.q: What does Lucas do every Sunday?
o: He walks Bolt in the park.
qs.ex: He walks Bolt in the park とあります。

o: A boy who buys a new dog.
A boy who helps a lost dog go home.
A dog that lives at a station.
qs.ex: 迷子の犬を飼い主のもとに帰してあげた男の子の話です。

lines: Did you look on your desk?
items.ex: 机になかった→「じゃあかばんの中を見てみたら」。
「今行こう」→「うん、ちょっと待って」。

lines: Excuse me. Is this seat free?
items.ex: すわっていいか聞かれて「もちろん」。

lines: What did you do last Sunday, Mike?
I went fishing with my dad.
items.ex: たくさん釣れたか聞かれて「2匹だけ」。

lines: Thank you. Do you want some more?
items.ex: おかわりを渡すときは Here you are.(はい、どうぞ)。

lines: Hello, Mr. Smith. Are you busy now?
Can you help me with my English homework?
items.ex: 「英語の宿題を手伝って」→「いいよ、見せて」。

lines: Thanks. It was a birthday present.
items.ex: Who(だれ)なので人で答えます。
「明日はどう?」→「明日ならいいよ」。

lines: Thank you. I lived in Canada for two years.
Oh, when did you come back to Japan?
items.ex: when(いつ)で過去のことなので Last spring(この前の春)。

lines: Yes. Do you want my scarf?
items.ex: 「本当にいいの?」→「うん、もう1本あるから」。

lines: Dad, can you take me to the station?
Sure. What time is your train?
OK. Let's leave home at three forty-five.
items.q: What time does the girl's train leave?
items.ex: It leaves at four fifteen. と言っています。3:45 は家を出る時間です。

lines: What did you do during the winter vacation, Emma?
I went skiing in Nagano with my cousins.
items.q: Who did Emma go skiing with?
items.ex: with my cousins(いとこと)と言っています。

lines: Yes. I want a birthday card for my mother.
How about this one with flowers?
items.q: What will the boy buy?
items.ex: a birthday card を買います。花は絵柄です。

lines: I got a good score on my math test.
items.q: Why is Kate happy?
o: She got a good score on her test.
items.ex: I got a good score on my math test. と言っています。

lines: Is there a supermarket near here?
Yes. Go straight and turn right at the hospital.
No. It's only five minutes on foot.
items.q: How long does it take to the supermarket on foot?
items.ex: only five minutes on foot(歩いて5分)と言っています。

lines: Are you going to the summer festival tonight?
Of course. Let's meet at the park at six.
items.q: Where will they meet?
items.ex: Let's meet at the park at six. と言っています。

lines: What are you looking for, Ben?
My history textbook. I can't find it.
I saw it on the sofa this morning.
items.q: Where was Ben's textbook?
items.ex: お母さんが on the sofa で見たと言っています。

lines: How was your trip to Okinawa?
It was great. The sea was beautiful.
items.q: How long did the girl stay in Okinawa?
items.ex: For a week.(1週間)と答えています。

lines: Do you want to play video games at my house?
I'd like to, but I have to practice the piano.
items.q: What does the girl have to do first?
items.ex: I have to practice the piano. と言っています。

lines: Excuse me. How much are these apples?
items.q: How many apples will the woman buy?
items.ex: I'll take four.(4つください)と言っています。

lines: I like cooking. Last Sunday, I made pancakes for my family. My father liked them very much. Next time, I want to make pizza.
items.q: What does the boy want to make next time?
items.ex: Next time, I want to make pizza. とあります。

lines: I have a lot of friends at school. My best friend is Aya. We are in the same tennis club. We practice together every day after school.
items.q: Who is the girl's best friend?
items.ex: My best friend is Aya. とあります。

lines: Attention, shoppers. The store will close in thirty minutes. Please bring the things you want to buy to the counter. Thank you for shopping with us.
items.q: When will the store close?
items.ex: The store will close in thirty minutes. とあります。

lines: My son, Taku, is a high school student. He wants to be a pilot. He studies English very hard. Every weekend, he goes to the airport to watch the planes.
items.q: What does Taku do every weekend?
items.ex: Every weekend, he goes to the airport とあります。

lines: Yesterday, I wanted to go to the beach with my friends. But it rained all day, so we watched a movie at my house. It was fun.
items.q: Why didn't the boy go to the beach?
items.ex: it rained all day(一日中雨だった)からです。

lines: I usually get up at six thirty. But this morning, my alarm clock didn't ring. I got up at seven thirty and ran to school.
items.q: What time did the girl get up this morning?
items.ex: I got up at seven thirty とあります。6:30 はふだんの時間です。

lines: Good morning, everyone. Today we're going to visit the science museum. The bus will leave at nine. Please don't forget your lunch and your notebooks.
items.q: What should the students bring?
items.ex: don't forget your lunch and your notebooks とあります。

lines: I have two children. My daughter is fifteen, and my son is eleven. My daughter plays the violin, and my son likes soccer.
items.q: How old is the man's son?
items.ex: my son is eleven とあります。15歳は娘です。

lines: Last month, my family moved to a new house. My new room is bigger than my old room. I can see the mountains from my window.
items.q: What can the girl see from her window?
items.ex: I can see the mountains from my window. とあります。

lines: I went to the library after school today. I wanted to borrow a book about stars, but someone had it. So I borrowed a book about dinosaurs.
items.q: What did the boy borrow?
items.ex: So I borrowed a book about dinosaurs. とあります。
